name: PT Sarana Mitra Luas Tbk
summary: Established in 1996 and headquartered in Bekasi, Indonesia, PT Sarana Mitra Luas Tbk is a dedicated provider of forklift rental services across the Indonesian market. The company offers a comprehensive suite of material handling solutions, extending beyond simple equipment leasing to include options for forklifts with or without operators, performance-based rental agreements, and even machinery installation. Furthermore, they facilitate both the sale and repair of forklifts. Their extensive inventory features a variety of equipment, such as engine-powered and electric counterbalanced forklifts, reach trucks, general warehousing machinery, loaders, and an assortment of forklift attachments. PT Sarana Mitra Luas Tbk serves a diverse client base, notably encompassing logistics firms, food and beverage producers, and electronics manufacturers.
